name: lsp
description: Language-server code intelligence: type-check an edit the moment it lands (LspDiagnostics), jump to a definition, find every reference, read a hover signature and list document or workspace symbols — all answered by the real language server for the file, not a text search. Elowen drives the servers it knows (TypeScript, Pyright, gopls, rust-analyzer, clangd, …) and can install the npm-based ones into its own prefix. Disabling it stops every language server and withdraws the tools.

configSchema.label: Live diagnostics
configSchema.hint: Type-check edits through language servers. Turning this off stops every running server; the tools stay listed and report that LSP is off. The `/lsp` command flips the same switch.

configSchema.label: Keep warm servers for
configSchema.hint: How long a language server with no check in flight stays ready for the next one. Each warm server keeps its project index in memory, so this is memory against the ~15 second restart. 0 keeps servers until the pool fills or LSP is turned off; a server whose project directory was deleted is released either way.
